name: Advance Grinding
verdict: Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) generated zero spend, leads, or clicks over the past 28 days, suggesting campaigns are paused or inactive. Google Business Profile was the only source of activity, driving 113 total actions (75 directions, 35 web clicks, 3 calls), though GBP engagement dropped 54.55% in the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, likely due to reduced organic search demand or a listing issue worth investigating.

performance.verdict: Paid ads fully dark; GBP collapsing — only active channel now fading.

findings.text: All paid channels (Meta + Google Ads) have recorded $0 spend and 0 leads for the full 45-day series — campaigns appear paused or disconnected.

GBP is the only active channel, but the 3-day signal (Aug 16–18: 2, 0, 0 actions) vs prior 3 days (Aug 13–15: 1, 2, 3) shows actions collapsing to zero — 28-day total is 113 actions, now stalling.
GA4 sessions are 0 across the entire 45-day series; with paid dark and GBP declining, there is no organic web traffic signal at all — site or tracking may be broken.
